top_events.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
top_events.label: US loses measles elimination status
top_events.summary: The United States lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, with over 5,400 cases and 10 deaths reported, marking a significant public health setback affecting American families nationwide.
